{{Quote|Only the greatest of all Sith are permitted to set foot in these chambers. You profane our entire history by your presence alone.|Darth Soverus, to Republic invaders|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Dark Council Chambers''', located inside the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], was the place where the [[Dark Council]] discussed anything related to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], their enemies and their plans.

The Chamber of the Dark Council consisted of six thrones at each side, one for each of the twelve Council members. If one of the Council was not present, he or she appeared as a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to participate in the Council's discussions.<ref name="TOR" />

There was also a [[Dark Council chamber (Dromund Kaas)|Dark Council chamber]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, the Chamber on Korriban was larger than its counterpart on Dromund Kaas.

Two notable duels took place in the Dark Council Chambers during the [[Galactic War]], namely the [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Galactic War)|duel]] between [[Darth Baras]] and the new [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath (Galactic War)]] and the [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Kaggath)|duel]] between [[Darth Thanaton]] and [[Darth Nox|Lord Kallig]].

During the [[Korriban Incursion]], the Council Chambers, along with most of the Sith Academy, were heavily damaged. [[Darth Soverus]], the only Dark Council Member planetside, was slain by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Jensyn]], who occupied the chambers until he was killed when the Empire retook the Academy.
